free_tier.stated: New accounts get free credit to try the API; the first top-up within 7 days adds up to USD 100 more: USD 10 gets USD 2, USD 50 gets USD 15, USD 250 gets USD 100. Paused sandboxes cost nothing.
free_tier.notes: The size of the starting free credit is not stated on either page, so it is unverified: behind a sign-up. No recurring sandbox allowance is published. Credits bought never expire; card top-ups add a processing fee.

per_object_cap.stated: Each sandbox has 25 GB of disk included and supports 1-8 vCPU and up to 16 GB of memory; no larger disk option is published.

retention.stated: A sandbox lives until the user deletes it, with no session time limit; after 5 idle minutes it pauses itself with memory and files intact, and paused sandboxes are free and kept. No maximum paused duration is published.

egress.terms: The sandbox page states no egress allowance or per-GB price; preview URLs are published per port and the sandbox has a network of its own.

interface_detail: E2B-compatible JS and Python SDKs and CLI work unchanged after setting E2B_DOMAIN=sandbox.openscale.so and E2B_API_KEY to the OpenScale key; commands, streaming, stdin, an interactive terminal, files, preview URLs and a headless browser are listed.
tooling: E2B SDKs for JavaScript and Python and an E2B-style CLI, with two environment variables changed; REST access is implied by the SDK compatibility.
chaining: The same API key works for models and sandboxes, so an agent can switch between inference and compute without a second credential; files and memory survive pause and resume.

limits.value: one-time free credit of unstated size for new accounts, plus up to USD 100 of top-up matching credit

limits_note: No platform fee, no minimum and no session time limit; a sandbox sleeps after 5 idle minutes. Volumes, secrets, fork and the snapshots API are not supported yet, and there is no GPU.
binding_note: The free credit is the first limit a new account meets, since there is no session cap and no platform fee; its size is not published, so the number of free hours is unverified.

identity_cost.detail: unverified: no captured or fresh first-party page states what the sign-up requires; the pricing page says only 'Create an account' to get an API key and the sandbox page says 'Sign in and copy it', while app.openscale.so/signup renders a startups marketing page with no form. The sign-up fields are unverified: behind a sign-up. Card top-ups from USD 5 with a processing fee are stated on the pricing page, but no card is shown at registration.

reliability_note: Sandboxes run in Singapore only; volumes, secrets, fork and the snapshots API are not supported, no GPU is offered, the free credit's amount is not published, and no page read states the registration identity.
confidence_note: The per-second rate, shape, concurrency, pause behaviour and lack of session cap were read from the first-party sandbox page today. No page read states the sign-up identity, so identity_cost.kind is a defaulted placeholder with an unverified detail; the free credit amount and signup fields are also unverified.
